name: Chemical Engineering
tagline: From hand-balanced reactions to a continuous-flow plant

milestones.title: Balance H₂ + O₂ → H₂O
milestones.objective: Use 2 H₂ and 1 O₂ atoms; produce 2 H₂O molecules.

milestones.title: Balance C + O₂ → CO₂
milestones.objective: Combust 1 C with 1 O₂; produce 1 CO₂.

milestones.title: Haber-Bosch: N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃
milestones.objective: Industrial ammonia synthesis. Watch for the 3:1 H₂:N₂ ratio.

milestones.title: Binary distillation column
milestones.objective: Separate ethanol-water with a 10-tray column. Hit 80% purity at the top tray.

milestones.title: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger
milestones.objective: Cool a 200°C process stream to 80°C with cooling water at 25°C. Match LMTD targets.

milestones.title: Continuous Stirred-Tank Reactor (CSTR)
milestones.objective: Run an exothermic reaction in a CSTR; design the cooling jacket.

milestones.title: Ethanol production flowsheet
milestones.objective: Sugar fermentation → distillation → dehydration. Steady state with ≥95% purity.

milestones.title: Pinch analysis
milestones.objective: Identify minimum heating + cooling utility for your flowsheet.

milestones.title: HAZOP study
milestones.objective: Run a hazard-and-operability study on the ammonia plant. Catch 5 failure modes.

milestones.title: Cold start the plant
milestones.objective: Bring an idle 100 kt/yr methanol plant to nameplate capacity in 4 sim hours.

milestones.title: Carbon capture retrofit
milestones.objective: Add an MEA absorber to your power plant flue. Recover 90% of CO₂.
